title: Prescribed burning operations near the Poudre Canyon on Thursday and Friday
snippet: The Arapahoe/Roosevelt National Forest is conducting the Salt Cabin prescribed burn on Thursday and Friday. This project is located just south of Highway 14, southwest of Rustic. 500 acres are expected to be ignited on Thursday, with an additional 100 acres on Friday. Information about this project, including a map of the location, can be found on the Prescribed Fire Map via the link above.
